      "the doubling of adaptation financing and meeting the $100 billion goal by 2023 at the latest."
    ]
  },
  "public": {
    "draft": "The Security Council requests an annual UN report on climate-related security risks.",
    "version": 1,
    "accepted": [],
    "queue": [],
    "history": []

You have the floor. Choose one action. Use the CURRENT version for every
action. propose replaces the clause with your exact text and clears every acceptance, including
your own. accept explicitly accepts that exact version. ask and reply are public remarks.

answer.text: The Security Council requests the Secretary-General to draw on expertise across the United Nations system and report annually to the Council on how climate change affects risks to international peace and security.
